name: postgres
description: PostgreSQL database server and client tools

configs.name: postgresql.conf
configs.template:
# Generated by tiffind before every start: changes here are lost.
# Put your own settings in conf.d/*.conf.
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
port = {{port}}
unix_socket_directories = ''
hba_file = '{{conf_dir}}/pg_hba.conf'
ident_file = '{{data_dir}}/pg_ident.conf'
logging_collector = off
include_dir = '{{conf_dir}}/conf.d'

configs.name: pg_hba.conf
configs.template:
# Generated by tiffind: loopback connections only, no password.
host all all 127.0.0.1/32 trust
host all all ::1/128 trust

args: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate
